title: Islamic Service Landscape — catalog schema v2

version.description: Catalog schema version. '2.0.0' or later means every serviceDomain carries controlRecord/rules/events/shariah.

catalogSchema.description: Filename of this schema, so a reader of the catalog can find its contract.

mergedFrom.description: The design fragments catalog/merge_fragments.py folded in. Provenance, not configuration.

shariahReview.description: The estate-wide honesty statement. reviewed MUST be false until a named SSB signs off; generate.py has no flag that overrides this.

functionalPatterns.description: The BIAN functional patterns in use. Every serviceDomain.functionalPattern must be one of these AND must be known to generate.py's PATTERN_NOUN table, or generation fails.

name.description: One Kubernetes namespace per business area — generate.py's AREA_NAMESPACE must have an entry for this exact string.

serviceDomain.description: One BIAN-style Islamic service domain = one generated repo (isb-<slug>). The first three properties are catalog v1 and are byte-compatible: an un-upgraded reader still sees {name, functionalPattern, assetType}.

source.description: Which design fragment this entry came from.

openBankingMapping.description: How this domain's fields surface on the openbank-islamic sibling resource server (DESIGN.md §7 RULE 3). Never on an OBIE path: RULE 1 forbids extending OBIE's own schemas.

uncertain.description: What the designing agent could NOT model, in its own words. A reported gap, never invented detail. Copied verbatim into the generated repo's docs/SHARIAH-GAPS.md.

controlRecord.description: The one BIAN control record this service domain manages. Generates: the OpenAPI ControlRecord schema (additionalProperties:false), the Flyway table, the JDBC repository and its RowMapper.

name.description: BIAN control-record name, e.g. 'Mudarabah Savings Account Fulfillment Arrangement'.

table.description: snake_case Postgres table name. Must be unique within the repo.

primaryKey.description: Name of the field that is the table's PRIMARY KEY. Must be a field of type 'id'.

stageField.description: Name of the enum field carrying the contract stage, where the domain has a staged lifecycle (Murabaha promise → acquisition → sale).

identifiers.description: Derived: the subset of fields[] that are identifiers. Informational; fields[] is authoritative.

money.description: Derived: the names of every field of type 'money'. Informational; fields[] is authoritative.

ratios.description: Derived: the names of every field of type 'ratio'.

fields.description: THE authority. Everything the generator emits for this record is derived from here and nowhere else.

behaviourQualifier.description: A BIAN behaviour qualifier = a generated sub-resource (GET /v1/<cr>/{crId}/<path>) plus its own child table. `bianProvenance`/`bianBQ` records whether BIAN actually has this BQ: BIAN has no Islamic constructs at all, so most are BIAN-STYLED, not BIAN.

path.description: URL segment under the control record.

actions.description: BIAN action terms offered on the sub-resource.

noSchema.description: true when the fragment described the BQ but gave it no fields. The generator emits NO table and NO path for it, and lists it in docs/RULES-GAPS.md. A documented intent is not a sub-resource.

field.description: One column / one OpenAPI property / one Java accessor. There is no 'free-form properties' escape hatch anywhere in schema v2 — that escape hatch is what produced 48 identical services.

sourceType.description: The type word the design fragment used, when it differed from the canonical one (e.g. 'moneyMinor' → 'money'). Audit trail for the normalisation.

values.description: REQUIRED when type is 'enum'. Becomes the OpenAPI enum and a SQL CHECK (col IN (...)).

const.description: The field may hold only this value. Becomes a single-valued OpenAPI enum and a SQL CHECK. This is how 'capitalAtRisk is not a product option' is expressed as code.

refDomain.description: REQUIRED when type is 'ref': the service domain that owns the referenced record. NEVER a SQL FOREIGN KEY — each service domain owns its own schema, and referential integrity is the caller's, asserted by contract tests.

currencyField.description: For type 'money': the name of the field carrying the ISO 4217 alpha-3 code for THIS amount. Omit when the record has exactly one field of type 'currency'. The exponent is looked up from one shared ISO 4217 table — BHD/KWD/OMR/TND are 3-decimal and JPY is 0-decimal, so a hardcoded ×100 is a bug.

signed.description: For type 'money': whether the amount may be negative. Minor units are int64 SIGNED on the wire and in the column regardless; this records whether a negative value is meaningful for the domain.

maxDenominator.description: For type 'ratio': the largest permitted denominator, so cross-multiplication of two ratios stays inside int64. REQUIRED on every ratio; merge_fragments.py supplies 1000000 where a fragment omitted it and flags that with maxDenominatorDefaulted.

maxDenominatorDefaulted.description: true when the bound was supplied by the merge, not by the designing agent. Visible rather than implicit.

items.description: For type 'array': the element type as a word, a single element schema, or a list of field definitions for an array-of-objects. The list form generates an inline OpenAPI object schema and a JSONB column.

format.description: Documented identifier format, e.g. 'MRB-<8 hex>'. Documentation only — the generator does not emit a regex from it.

derived.description: true when the value is computed from other fields; the generated column is still stored, and the arithmetic identity is asserted by a rule.

then.description: An enum with no values generates a free-form string column — exactly the silent-scaffold failure this schema exists to stop.
A ref with no refDomain is an undeclared cross-service dependency.
A ratio with no bound on its denominator cannot be compared by cross-multiplication without risking int64 overflow. ProfitSharingRatio is an EXACT ratio: numerator/denominator int64, never a float.

fieldType.description:
The closed type vocabulary. Mapping (OpenAPI / Postgres / Java):
  id        string / VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY / String
  ref       string / VARCHAR(64), no FK / String
  string    string / TEXT / String
  enum      string+enum / TEXT + CHECK IN / String
  bool      boolean / BOOLEAN / Boolean
  int32     integer int32 / INTEGER / Integer
  int64     integer int64 / BIGINT / Long
  money     integer int64 / BIGINT (signed MINOR units) / Long
  ratio     object {numerator,denominator} int64 / two BIGINT columns / Ratio
  currency  string ^[A-Z]{3}$ / CHAR(3) / String
  countryCode string ^[A-Z]{2}$ / CHAR(2) / String
  date      string date / DATE / LocalDate
  timestamp string date-time / TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE / OffsetDateTime
  period    object {from,to} dates / two DATE columns / Period
  array     array / JSONB / List
There is deliberately no 'decimal', no 'float' and no 'number'.

rule.description: One Shariah or arithmetic invariant. generator/rules_lang.py translates `assert` into a SQL CHECK and/or a Java predicate when every identifier in it resolves to a control-record field and it uses only the restricted grammar; otherwise the rule is emitted as UNIMPLEMENTED in the generated registry and listed in docs/RULES-GAPS.md. An unimplemented rule is a reported gap — it is never silently dropped and never silently claimed.

id.description: Stable rule id, e.g. ISB-MUDS-02. Unique within the domain; used as the generated test and method name.

assert.description: The invariant, as an expression. Restricted grammar (translated to SQL + Java): field names, string/int/bool literals, ( ), ! && || -> , comparisons == != < <= > >= , arithmetic + - * , `x in [a,b]`, and present(f)/absent(f)/isSet(f)/exists(f). Anything else — count(), sum(), forall(), bq.*, `where`, immutable(), appendOnly() — is OUT of the translated subset by design and is reported, not approximated.

onViolation.description: reject = the write fails. flag = the write succeeds and a Shariah-non-compliance finding is appended to the audit trail (DESIGN.md §5.8).

enforcedAt.description: Where the rule is meant to bite. 'db-check' also emits the Java predicate, because a service that trusts the database alone cannot report WHICH rule failed.

errorCode.description: The stable code the API returns and the audit record carries.

citation.description: AAOIFI / IFSB / BNM references supporting the rule, by body and number. NO clause here was read from a primary standard text: the citations come from this estate's research record, and generated code marks them clauseVerified:false. A rule with no citation is an arithmetic identity or an engineering invariant, not a Shariah claim.

appliesTo.description: The action terms the rule is checked on (initiate, update, control, …). Default: all writes.

test.description: The designing agent's prose test vector. Prose, so the generator cannot execute it; it is copied into the generated test as a javadoc comment so a human can.

event.description: One AsyncAPI channel in the generated api/events.yaml. payload[] must name control-record or behaviour-qualifier fields; a payload naming a field that does not exist is a contract that cannot be filled, and validation rejects it.

topic.description: Kafka topic. Must start with the business-area namespace in dotted form, e.g. isb.deposits.…

shariah.description: The Shariah surface of the domain. `reviewed` is const false: there is no catalog value and no generator flag that can set it true. Only a named Shariah supervisory board can, and that is a change to this schema, not to a data file.

contractType.description: DESIGN.md §7's enum, plus the values the design agents had to raise because §7's list does not cover them (Takaful, Retakaful, Tabarru, Ujrah, Musharakah, Mudarabah-Wakala hybrids, 'None' for governance domains). Those are RAISED CONTRADICTIONS, not silent extensions — see the generated docs/SHARIAH-GAPS.md.

capitalAtRisk.description: true ⇒ the balance is NOT a liability of the bank and a CBPII funds confirmation against it must REFUSE, not answer FundsAvailable:true (DESIGN.md §7, behavioural rule). Generates the fundsConfirmationSupported CHECK.

standards.description: Cited by body and number only. clauseVerified is false for every one of them. Two fragment dialects are accepted: a prose string, or a structured citation {body, code, clause?, title?, note?} — the governance and financing agents wrote the structured form and it is the better one.

body.description: AAOIFI | IFSB | BNM | REGULATOR | ISO | … Optional because one fragment folded the body into `code`; the merge lifts it out when the code's leading token names a known body and leaves it absent rather than guessing.

clause.description: Clause reference AS RECORDED BY THE RESEARCH, not as read from the primary text.

ref.description: Alias for `code` as two fragments wrote it; merge_fragments.py renames it.

clauseVerified.description: Set to false by the merge for every structured citation, without exception.
